_comment: Claims a dimension-stamped review wisp and writes its REVIEW or BLOCKED verdict on the linked node. The wisp's parent is that node under `bd create --parent <node> --ephemeral`; a relates-to or replies-to link also counts. REVIEW carries verdict=approve|changes; BLOCKED carries reason=<cause>. Both carry dimension=<d> head_sha=<sha> review_round=<n>, with dimension from the wisp and version fields from the wisp, falling back to the node only when absent. G4 requires all three tokens to match. A security reviewer runs the native exact-head scan and stamps its published security_scan_ref plus security_scan_head=head_sha on the node and wisp before REVIEW; the native store must prove completed full ref-diff coverage and operation provenance. Security BLOCKED may omit scan fields when no result was published. Approval closes the wisp; changes release it open for the next round. Neither bypasses exit: the claimed wisp is judged on the linked node's exact verdict, not the wisp's own comments. metadata.role is absent from deny_metadata because routing is architect-authored and enforced at the G5 write seam; bd create remains exempt so roles can file routable work.

completion.recovery: write REVIEW with plan=<current plan hash>
write REVIEW with override=<current acceptance hash>
write REVIEW with nodes=<id>:<current acceptance hash>:met|unmet for every integrated id
